toml:
# LEO-PNT vertical: wireless networks, 5G/6G base-station timing.
#
# A 5G time-division-duplex (TDD) base station in Madrid needs its time within 1.5
# microseconds of every other cell's (ITU-T G.8271 accuracy class 4 at the end
# application; 1.1 microseconds at the network reference point, G.8271.1). Its
# oven-controlled crystal oscillator (OCXO) is disciplined to GNSS. When GNSS is lost for
# a day:
#
#   * the `telecom-timing` kind runs the operator's own holdover analysis of the OCXO
#     (temperature cycling of 2 K, the kind's G.8271.1 and G.8272 budgets): the events mark
#     when its time error crosses the 1100 ns network limit and the 1500 ns end-application
#     limit;
#   * a `leo-pvt` timing run disciplines the same class of oscillator to the Xona Pulsar X5
#     signal (public signal table, arXiv 2509.19551; both published shells, 258 satellites
#     at about 1080 km) and converts system time to UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) with
#     the broadcast offset, holding between passes;
#   * a `leo-pass` run of the four highest Pulsar passes over the site carries the geometry
#     the campaign exports.
#
# The alarm is raised on the LEO-disciplined time error against the 1100 ns network limit.
#
# MODELLED: the two oscillator models are each kind's own (the telecom kind's OCXO with
# temperature and ageing terms, the timing run's OCXO class noise), so the comparison is
# between the two analyses, not one oscillator; the X5 range error is the preset's.
kind = "campaign"
title = "5G base-station timing: holdover and LEO time"
seed = 20260929

[timeline]
step_s = 300.0

[[phases]]
name = "gnss-lost"
duration_s = 86400.0

[[phases.runs]]
events = [
  { label = "OCXO holdover exceeds the 1100 ns network limit", at = "budgets[0].time_to_exceed_s" },
  { label = "OCXO holdover exceeds the 1500 ns end-application limit", at = "budgets[1].time_to_exceed_s" },
]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "telecom-timing"
seed = 20260929
masks = ["prtc-a"]
[phases.runs.scenario.holdover]
oscillator = "ocxo"
gnss_loss_s = 0.0
duration_s = 86400.0
sample_interval_s = 1.0
locked_te_sigma_ns = 1.0
initial_frequency_offset = 0.0
temperature_amplitude_k = 2.0
temperature_period_s = 86400.0
locked_duration_days = 5.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.budgets]]
name = "network limit at reference point C"
max_abs_te_ns = 1100.0
source = "ITU-T G.8271.1 (2022) Amd. 3 (05/2025) clause 7.3.1 (max|TE_L|, compared unfiltered)"
[[phases.runs.scenario.budgets]]
name = "end application, accuracy class 4"
max_abs_te_ns = 1500.0
source = "ITU-T G.8271 (03/2020) Amd. 1 (08/2024) Table 1, class 4"

[[phases.runs]]
series = [
  { channel = "leo_time_error_ns", unit = "ns", t = "timing.rows[0].series[].t_s", y = "timing.rows[0].series[].error_ns" },
  { channel = "leo_time_sigma_ns", unit = "ns", t = "timing.rows[0].series[].t_s", y = "timing.rows[0].series[].sigma_ns" },
]
alarms = [{ channel = "leo_time_error_ns", compare = "abs_above", threshold = 1100.0 }]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "leo-pvt"
mode = "timing"
seed = 21
duration_s = 86400.0
step_s = 60.0
[phases.runs.scenario.user]
lat_deg = 40.42
lon_deg = -3.70
height_m = 650.0
[phases.runs.scenario.timing]
clocks = ["ocxo"]
cn0_offsets_db = [0.0]
week = 2436
tow0_s = 172800.0
trace = true
[phases.runs.scenario.timing.utc]
a0_s = 4.0e-9
a1_s_per_s = 1.0e-14
t_ot_s = 147456.0
wn_t = 2436
delta_t_ls_s = 18.0
sigma_s = 5.0e-9
[[phases.runs.scenario.system]]
name = "Pulsar X5"
leo_preset = "xona-pulsar"
signal = "X5"
mask_deg = 10.0

[[phases.runs]]
series = [
  { channel = "pulsar_pass_elevation_deg", unit = "deg", t = "satellites[0].series[].t_s", y = "satellites[0].series[].elevation_deg" },
]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "leo-pass"
name = "Pulsar passes over the base station"
epoch = "2026-09-28T08:00:00"
duration_s = 900.0
step_s = 10.0
[phases.runs.scenario.user]
environment = "ground"
lat_deg = 40.42
lon_deg = -3.70
height_m = 650.0
mask_deg = 10.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.leo_constellation]]
system = "xona-pulsar"
bands = ["X5"]
max_satellites = 4
[phases.runs.scenario.gnss]
constellation = "galileo"
band = "E1"
summary: campaign ca7926631f76 | 5G base-station timing: holdover and LEO time | chain: 1 phases over 86400 s, 2 events, alarm raised on 0 s of the grid | 3 member runs (MODELLED)
